correctness.rationale: The explicit u=sum(P_alpha d_alpha) conjugates every finite commuting partition of orthogonal idempotents to its diagonal in A^H; nilpotent radical ensures u is a unit. The stabilizer of diagonal projectors inside 1+J^H has precisely one free parameter per monochromatic orbit of strict comparable pairs, giving the \(q^b\) fiber. Burnside and the crown quotient cycle transfer matrix prove the orbit formula, including \(d=1\) multiedges. Literal small-field incidence-product checks and separate graph orbit enumerations replay successfully. Finite tests are corroborative, not complete proof.

value.rationale: A naturally motivated multi-projector counting question and its symmetry-fixed variants on all finite poset incidence algebras reduce to explicit weighted quotient-comparability graph colorings. The diagonal fibers also yield the complete irreducible-component/dimension classification of the reduced commuting-idempotent variety, with top dimensions governed by a maximum-color-cut invariant. The all-parameter crown totient/transfer formula yields exact rotational orbit spectra, not a routine relabeling of single-idempotent counts. Works uniformly without semisimplicity of the automorphism group action in the field characteristic, and supplies a reusable structural counting tool.
